decisions.reason: Locating the master power control on the front panel does not change supply capacity, supported loads, controller sizing, or overload protection.
The control location does not change the prototype's use of a standard 120V wall outlet.
The source proposes a physical location for the power control but does not necessarily change any component selection or BOM deliverable state.
Placing the power control on the front panel does not change the placard wording, side placement, or viewing orientations.
The dispense buttons are used only as positional references; the source does not change spout geometry, material, mounting, or orientation.
The master power control's front-panel position has no necessary effect on splash targets or mitigation measures.
The source does not change the unit's stability behavior, base, feet, or vibration-control requirements.
The location of the master power control does not alter spout removability, flushing, or cleaning behavior.
The two dispense buttons are pre-existing positional references; the source does not change their dispensing behavior, valve mechanism, flow, or sequence.
The source specifies control placement but does not change any body, accent, support-base, or font color.
Front-panel power-control placement does not affect bowl capacity, depth, refilling policy, or bowl design priorities.
The source locates one control on the existing front panel but does not necessarily alter enclosure thickness, size, or overall form factor.
